input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restraint binds our business, so the Agreement meets the preferred position. The "Field of Use" definition (p0007) and the Article II "Additional Restrictions" (p0035, p0040–p0047), together with Article VI (p0085) and p0027, only limit how we may use, copy, modify or redistribute the Licensor's Licensed Technology; they are ordinary licence-scope limits and do not restrict the businesses we operate or the products we may buy or build. The licence is expressly non-exclusive on both sides (p0043), and we are free to use or build competing FX platforms. Article X contains only nondisclosure and a non-solicitation of Licensor employees (p0125) — a personnel covenant, not a non-compete, and outside this rule's scope. Noted but not flagged here: the Change of Control consent right that may be withheld where the acquirer is "directly or indirectly competitive" with Licensor (p0134) and the Right of First Refusal over a sale of Licensee (p0139) constrain our exit rather than our operations or procurement; they belong to the assignment/change-of-control rules and should be addressed there rather than double-flagged under NONCOMPETE.
